alt.en: A large violet block marked with an equals sign stands in the center of a gray floor. On the left, a blue cube of model weights sends a dashed orange line with one packet to it. On the right, a standing gray page joins it with a dotted gray line.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一块标有等号的紫色大方块。左侧是蓝色的模型权重立方体，一条带数据包的橙色虚线连到方块；右侧是一张竖立的灰色文件，以灰色点线与方块相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a model's weights and a posted training blueprint both feed a comparison of gradient statistics, as the SciCheck authors propose. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：按照 SciCheck 作者提出的设计，模型权重与已发布的训练蓝图一起接受梯度统计比较。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不表明这些检查能如所述般起效。
